sources.title: Introducing Gemma 3 270M: The compact model for hyper-efficient AI
sources.snippet: Explore Gemma 3 270M, a compact, energy-efficient AI model for task-specific fine-tuning, offering strong instruction-following and production-ready quantization.

sources.title: Atomic-Germ/Gemma4-E2B-IT-NPU2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on small models) and generating text output. This release includes open-weights models in both pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants. Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages.

sources.title: Gemma 3 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 3 is the most capable model that can run on a single GPU or TPU. Efficient on workstations, laptops, and even smartphones, allowing developers to build responsible AI applications at scale.

sources.title: Own your AI: Learn how to fine-tune Gemma 3 270M and run it on-device
sources.snippet: Learn to fine-tune and deploy Gemma 3 270M on-device. Create custom AI models, like a personal emoji generator, that run in-browser for a fast, private UX.
